assessment_objectives.objective: embedded technologies (e.g., Operational Technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) devices) are identified and their network connectivity is documented.

embedded technologies are logically (e.g., segmented zones and conduits, firewalls, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs)) or physically separated from organizational Information Technology (IT) networks.
network traffic permitted between embedded technology environments and organizational Information Technology (IT) networks is restricted to documented, authorized flows.

the separation of embedded technologies from organizational Information Technology (IT) networks is verified at a defined frequency through network architecture review, configuration review and/or testing.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change
